{{Quote|The main superstructure has been reinforced, and trimantium plating lines the hull to provide the ship with unsually high tensile strength.|C-D20 describes the HT-2200 medium freighter|<ref name="ABGTAS" />}}
'''Trimantium''' was a [[Color/Legends|gray-green]]<ref name="Shadow" /> metal which could be used to make [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating for [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="ABGTAS" /> The metal was used in the creation of weapons and armor during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Shadow" />

The [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] model of ship, which was made by the starship manufacturer [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], had trimantium plating lining the [[Hull/Legends|hull]], giving the ship unusually high tensile strength. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-D20]] mentioned that feature when describing the model to a [[Unidentified Rebel (hangar)|Rebel]] looking for a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to use for his next mission.<ref name="ABGTAS" /> Also, the HT-2200 ''[[Karbarr's Fortress]]'' boasted additional armor plating over the standard trimantium hull, and was for sale by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships|used-starship salesman]] [[Fiz Cor'gril]].<ref name="FSUS">{{JournalCite|9|Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships (article)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trimantium was first mentioned in [[1995]] in the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]].<ref name="ABGTAS" /> It later appeared in the [[2014]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', which added it as a Grade 8 Underworld Metal that was used in the creation of various armor pieces and weapons.<ref name="Shadow" />
